Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX Version for session, i.e. 'FIX.4.4'

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Number of bytes in the message body.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Identifies FIX message type.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number. Must be set to 'Y' for messages sent in response to a Resend Request from Coinbase Derivatives

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Connection identifier assigned by Coinbase Derivatives. This tag consists of 2 subcomponents: SubFirm ID and Session ID SubFirm ID is the left-most 3 characters. The next 3 characters represent Session ID. Example: EBR123 SubFirm ID: EBR Session ID: 123 From Exchange: Value from order entry tag 56-TargetCompID - "COIND"

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the end trader submitting orders. Tag 50 IDs are issued by an exchange clearing member firm (clearing member), their contracted vendors or assignees

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Can be used to identify the end trader submitting orders if Tag 50 is populated by a third party connection provider.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Timestamp of the message leaving the client system.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Identifies entity receiving the message = "COIND" From Exchange Connection identifier assigned by Coinbase Derivatives. This tag consists of 2 subcomponents: SubFirm ID and Session ID SubFirm ID is the left-most 3 characters. The next 3 characters represent Session ID. Example: EBR123

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: To Exchange: Identifies destination exchange system - "PROD" or "TEST" From Exchange: Echo back Tag57 sent by client system

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For resent messages only, contains timestamp from tag 52-SendingTime from original message.

Field.Name: LastMsgSeqNumProcessed
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum (34) of the last message from the client received and processed by the gateway.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always last tag in message. Functions as end-of-message delimiter.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: "0" - None. Security must be guaranteed on transport level

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds - Allowed values are between 5s and 60s, 30s is recommended

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: "N" - use previous sequences "Y" - reset sequences (start new session). If clients cannot recover the previous session they start new session with 1 and set this field to "Y". The flag should be used with caution especially during trading session as this might lead to business data loss

Field.Name: Username
Field.Description: Username

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Logout reason

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the last message in range to be resent

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: "N" - sequence reset, the counterparty must adjust inbound sequence number. "Y" - indicates the message is used instead of administrative or business messages which are not to be resent

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New adjusted sequence number

Field.Description: Identifier to be returned in resulting Heartbeat message

Field.Description: Sequence number of the rejected message
